# Creator Mention Research Template

This template is for documenting public creator, influencer, and brand mentions found in competitor captions or public content records.

This is not a contact scraping template.

## Boundary

Do not use this template for:

- collecting private contact information
- scraping emails or phone numbers
- bulk outreach
- automated DMs
- private account monitoring
- harassment or spam
